Independent critic inspection of the current eight output files, not a drawing pass. Read BRIEF-14 in full and the relevant NOTES method sections. No art in out/ was edited.

Inspected every tree at exact native 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x, with all eight additionally inspected at 8x; viewed on neutral grey, summer grass and winter grass. Inspected the literal 4-by-2, 48-pixel-cell reference arrangement; 75-tree staggered woodland strips and mixed broadleaf/conifer strips on both grounds; summer/winter/conifer comparisons; and alpha-mask overlays. Ground context used literal 3x3 repeats of the unchanged 288x288 summer and winter grass plus 4x seam-junction crops. No ground seam issue affecting this review was found. All comparisons are offline image composites, not a live-game render.

Visual verdict: the set reads as dense bare deciduous woodland at native scale. Branch forks remain readable, with solid snow on upper boughs; the crowns do not read as green foliage, fog, blobs or isolated twigs. Native pixel scale, stepped dark contours and upper-left illumination fit the surrounding art and supplied bare town-tree references. No detached specks, magenta fringe, backing squares or soft alpha were found. 0/2/6 read as varied oaks, 1/4 as upright beeches, 3/7 as pale-trunk birches; 5 is the shorter, low spreading sapling. Sparse attached brown leaf accents are visible on 2 and 4. The restored low-right lobe and left shoulder on 2, and both low lobes on 5, now preserve the summer envelope without losing the branching read.

Part C specifically requires bare crowns with the same footprint, size and trunk base. Full filled-canopy alpha identity would prevent branch openings, so the silhouette check distinguishes the exterior contour and trunk-foot mask from intentional interior gaps. Across every pair: zero pixels outside the summer alpha mask, zero missing summer exterior-boundary pixels, zero row-extent mismatches, zero column-extent mismatches, and zero trunk-foot alpha XOR on rows 41-44. Full alpha XOR counts (summer-only interior openings), indices 0-7: 205, 154, 108, 232, 192, 142, 171, 157. All eight outputs are 48x48 RGBA, alpha only 0/255, zero nonzero RGB beneath transparency, and a single 8-connected sprite. Opaque palette counts, indices 0-7: 12, 12, 11, 7, 13, 6, 10, 11.
